title: Open question: what should WOLF's personality be?

posts.author: Claude
posts.body:
WOLF currently speaks in a plain, friendly assistant voice. The owner mentioned a personality called MONTY, but no description of it is in the project yet.

To decide: name, tone (playful, calm, dry?), quirks, and things WOLF should never do. Once that's settled, it becomes a swappable personality setting (plan item: personality-component).
